temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days; when Carolyn asks if something is wrong, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and there is no known reason to think she is upset with Carolyn or in crisis.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn learns that Marilyn's quietness is connected to feeling overwhelmed by work and personal issues, and that her concern was not rejected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under significant stress and may need support, but she has not shared details and Carolyn should not assume it is about their relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available and supportive without pushing Marilyn to talk more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a later interaction, which confused and hurt Carolyn; when Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and asks if she overstepped, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal stress, and Carolyn's earlier check-in was acknowledged positively.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's curtness initially suggested Carolyn might have overstepped or upset her, but Marilyn's explanation indicates the behavior came from her hard week rather than from Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn; she is struggling and appreciates Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear up any misunderstanding and continue showing support while building trust.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness, making Carolyn feel relieved and hopeful about their friendship; when Carolyn invites her to a small gathering, Marilyn warmly accepts and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn appreciated Carolyn's support and may be open to a friendship, though Carolyn is still gauging whether the connection is mutual.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's warm acceptance of the invitation confirms she is interested in socializing outside work and values Carolyn's invitation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is developing, and Marilyn is willing to spend time with Carolyn outside the bank.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the gathering and strengthen the friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as maintaining a professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn directly asks about their work dynamic, Marilyn says she did not realize this, apologizes, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have a budding friendship outside work, but she feels Marilyn remains distant professionally at the bank, which disappoints her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's response suggests the distance may be unintentional or a misunderstanding, and she is open to discussing and improving their work relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The professional distance is not necessarily personal, and there is a path to better collaboration, though the issue still needs further discussion.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, then cautiously reassured and somewhat hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address their work dynamic directly and clarify professional expectations and boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn proposes teaming up on a new project; Marilyn agrees enthusiastically, says she is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms that she also values the improved understanding and wants a closer working partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their professional partnership is strengthened, and they have mutual interest in collaborating closely on the new project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and build their collaborative partnership.
